name: Temporary ULN - One POST, Two Courses, Then Corrected With Real ULNs
description: Single provider first POSTs one short course learner using the temporary/placeholder ULN 9999999999, enrolled on two different courses in the same request (same start date, different course codes, no approval/milestones). The SLD then submits a correction: two further POSTs, identical in structure, but each course is now assigned to its own proper, distinct ULN - revealing they were two different learners all along.

SLD Correction - Learner Two, Course ZSC00002, Real ULN
